title: The Lord’s words are tried silver — lend them well
english: The preacher lends the Lord’s coin: [[The words of the Lord are pure words, silver refined >> Bible:Psalm 12:6]]. Bad teaching is [[rejected silver >> Bible:Jeremiah 6:30]]; good teaching yields interest. [[I desire mercy and not sacrifice >> Bible:Hosea 6:6]].
